observer_schema.index: role*6+owner*3+phase; manifest omits zero-call stats, raw stores all
events_fields: initial safe raw scan clone retained
observer_schema.net: gross minus freed; no measured per-phase peak

correctness.plan_height_control: Auto BreakPlan height0/unbounded retry vs direct first accepted, outside all windows; block/float excluded

scope.time: 4 final fresh counterfree CPU10 processes7samples,2warmups percase/op; median of process medians. Standard/rich sections stay in fixed order; reverse applies within each section plus operation/retry ordering. All builds/checks/native verifier finished before final captures. Initial balanced captures overlap native verification and are controls only, all retained. Input/build/configured fonts/context creation/full snapshots/fresh oracle/plan-height controls outside windows. Whole standard operation uses unchanged public workload::layout; rich measured driver includes percall warning drain/drop and bounded progress checks. Not end-to-end/frame.
scope.memory: Requested whole-operation gross/freed/net/peak and owner releases; not RSS. Net cost contains accepted output+context caches; cost+output release is incremental context growth only from operation, not total retained context or font/input owners. Output release includes its enclosing Run/LineResult Vecs and recursive owned geometry, not one cached trial. No single CompletedTrial/clone memory measurement or predicted net cache benefit. All measured requested samples are identical with observer.
scope.phases: Noalloc fixed stack/snapshot observer; actual freshscan/samewidth branches and2shapers. Inc/excl nested root/annotation, do not sum inclusive. Materialization includes rejectedLine destruction/height gate; root post-scan contains materialization, excludes scan. Counterfree totals determine current algorithm cost; observer phase time includes overhead and is not predicted savings. Peak only wholeoperation.
scope.algorithm: PartialLine already reuses clean raw scan on exact samewidth retries; unsafe/tab/warning paths may deliberately rescan. Existing .1 per-line edge-spend reset preserved. Scope is remaining geometry. No shipping core/API/limit change, no saved spikes/S4gate/RSS/frame/parallel/global guarantees.

validation.std54: Original54workloads used in diagnostic; standard harness/source fingerprints unchanged. Latest CI required.

decision.adopt: Conditional private one-entry CompletedTrial or proven height-only stage implementation candidate; repeated remaining geometry is measured. No shipping cache/bypass or speedup claimed.
key: exact float cursor and relevant placed/inset constraints
immutable limits/budget policy and eligible resource/cache state
decision.eligibility: Start with completed warning-free unsuppressed/resource-fallback-free trials only, conservative data/cache eligibility. Continue original path for ineligible inputs. Height-specific sanitization/warnings must still execute. Warning/budget state/replay and accepted continuation must match original sequence, not only isolated first line.
decision.ownership: At most one immutable owned completed Line per LayoutContext; replace/evict on any key change. Returning accepted Line may take slot and evict, avoiding a mandatory clone; subsequent same-token queries recompute normally. If retained plus cloned acceptance is chosen, measure actual clone allocations. Cached rejection retains a Line that baseline frees, explicitly charged.
decision.retention: Explicit retained-byte budget, initially proposed64KiB private cap per context, charge Line header and all owned Vec capacities/overlays/recursive Ruby geometry, exclude shared immutable owners from incremental charge but keep their lifetime explicit. Budget eviction/shrink0 drops entry; oversized/ineligible candidate never cached. This cap is a proposed policy, not implemented/measured runtime; current output release is aggregate owner cost, not per-entry prediction.
contracts: warnings order/content/cap/suppression and height sanitizer even on hit; original fallback for any warning/resource limited trial until exact replay proven
per-line spend reset and actual resource/cache dependencies; no generic reset-bypassing assumption
private plan/font/atomic changes invalidate entry; no unbounded cache
counterfree candidate+baseline captures and standalone cached/clone owner retention/peak proof before ship; no unimplemented gains
saved spikes unchanged and S4switch independent
